notes: The pricing toggle was captured on 'Yearly 20% off': Pro shows 'starts at $79 / month billed yearly'; the monthly-billed Pro price is not in the snapshot, so only 79 is listed. Pro is also scaled by tracked users (100+, automatic upgrade to the next tier), hence 'usage' is accepted. Business has no displayed price ('Let's talk', 'Custom'). 'Plans for B2C' and non-profit discounts are not plans. Gong is also prominently named as a feedback source (6-integration cap). ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor are MCP clients; counting them as integrations is acceptable but they were not selected. '100K+ registered companies' and testimonials are company claims, not payment proof. The MCP pages mention LLMs as product features; they contain no instruction aimed at an AI reader.
